Hmm. 8508.11: dry vacuum cleaners. Wet and dry → 8508.19.00? CBP ruling on Roborock wet/dry robot vacuum classified 8508.11.00? I recall NY rulings classifying wet/dry robot vacuums in 8508.11.00.
